source: Each entry says where its shape comes from. Exit codes and `glab:` stderr lines follow glab's api command source (gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli, internal/commands/api/api.go: GraphQL and HTTP >= 400 errors print `glab: <message>` and exit 1).

invalid-token.source: Live body and status: gitlab.com GraphQL with a made-up bearer token, 2026-11-04.

keyring-token-missing.source: glab source, internal/api/client.go: the client is never built, so no request is sent and nothing reaches stdout.
keyring-token-missing.stderr: the token for "gitlab.com" is missing from the operating system keyring; run `glab auth login --hostname gitlab.com` to re-authenticate

throttled.source: GitLab docs, administration/settings/user_and_ip_rate_limits.md: Rack::Attack answers 429 with a plain-text `Retry later` body and Retry-After in seconds.

quota-spent.source: GitLab docs, same page: every response carries RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset (Unix time). Body is a live shape.

older-gitlab-without-closes.source: Live shape of gitlab.com's answer to an unknown MergeRequest field (asked as `bogusField` on 2026-11-04), with the field name set to the one older servers lack.
older-gitlab-without-closes.stderr: glab: Field 'workItemRelations' doesn't exist on type 'MergeRequest'
